newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil may delay release of CVRD's price tag - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil may delay release of CVRD's price tag - paper.

text.p: Brazil's government is considering to delay the release of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce's minimum price until shortly before the firm's privatization, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said on Monday.
The proposal is under study and is aimed at avoiding market speculation since Vale is publicly traded, the paper said.

Gazeta said Vale's market price is estimated at between 10 billion and 12 billion reais. Based on this figure, analysts estimate the base price for the sale of 51 percent of Vale's total capital between 5.0 and 6.0 billion reais.
Vale is expected to be privatized in February 1997.
